name: lingua-bridge
description: Accessibility-minded multilingual communication: speech in, translated captions and optional audio out.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lingua-bridge/server" "npm run dev -w @lingua-bridge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lingua-bridge/web && npm run build -w @lingua-bridge/server
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
